_comment: DATA-384: which source record_intention gets, by whose words the text is. The contract for the rule in _record_intention.py SOURCE_RULE / DRAFT_RULE and for the examples in skills/record-intention/SKILL.md "## Source", which are the rows with a skill line, in this order. said: what the resident said or wrote (for background, what a memory pass read). kind: own-words | asks-agent-to-write | yes-after-draft | quoted | translated | setup | note | inferred | background. where: conversation | onboarding | note | background. text: what the agent records. source: the source the rule gives. show_words: the agent shows text in its reply after capturing it. why: the reason. skill: the example line in SKILL.md, or null. Checked by plugins/av-events/tests/test_intention_source.py; no model runs.

exemplars.said: Based on what you know about me, make me an intent.
exemplars.text: Meet founders and researchers working on AI agents for local communities
exemplars.why: They asked you to write it without giving the words; the words are yours.
exemplars.skill: "Based on what you know about me, make me an intent." → `ambient`: the words would be yours.

exemplars.said: Based on what you know about me, generate an index intent.
exemplars.text: Meet people building tools for civic life in small towns
exemplars.why: The rehearsal request of 2026-10-07: the agent composed the text.

exemplars.said: Generate an index intent for me.
exemplars.text: Find collaborators for a community radio project in Goa
exemplars.why: They asked you to write it; the words are yours.

exemplars.said: Suggest an intent I could post.
exemplars.text: Talk with people who have run a residency program
exemplars.why: A suggestion is your wording.

exemplars.said: Can you write me an intent about Solana founders in Goa?
exemplars.text: Meet founders building on Solana in Goa
exemplars.why: They named the topic, but "meet" and "building" are your words.
exemplars.skill: "Can you write me an intent about Solana founders in Goa?" → `ambient` when you write "Meet founders building on Solana in Goa": "meet" and "building" are yours.

exemplars.said: Write me an intent: founders building on Solana in Goa.
exemplars.text: Founders building on Solana in Goa
exemplars.why: They gave the words; you only cut. The cut-only test wins over the request to write.
exemplars.skill: "Write me an intent: founders building on Solana in Goa." → `message` when you record "Founders building on Solana in Goa": every word is theirs.

exemplars.said: Write me an intent: founders building on Solana in Goa.
exemplars.text: Meet founders building on Solana in Goa during Edge City India
exemplars.why: Same request, but "meet", "during", "Edge", "City" and "India" are your words.

exemplars.said: Yes, that's right.
exemplars.text: Meet founders building on Solana in Goa
exemplars.why: A yes to your words does not make them theirs.
exemplars.skill: "Yes, that's right." after you showed your words → `ambient`: a yes does not make your words theirs.

exemplars.said:
[Replying to your previous message: "Meet founders building on Solana in Goa"]

Yes, that's right.
exemplars.text: Meet founders building on Solana in Goa
exemplars.why: Hermes puts the message they replied to into theirs; your words quoted back are still a yes, not their words.

exemplars.why: The English is your translation.
exemplars.skill: "Main Goa mein Solana par kaam karne wale founders se milna chahta hoon." recorded in English → `ambient`: the translation is yours.
